method: Estimate relative image homographies from shared corner IDs, decompose with the saved RGB K and filter visible-point cheirality. No board square or marker size is used. Report all physically visible branch angle magnitudes and their minimum robot discrepancy.
limitations: Known RGB intrinsics and a rigid planar stationary board are assumed.
The minimum over visible branches is an optimistic discrepancy bound, not a chosen physical pose.
Does not distinguish camera intrinsic error, board nonplanarity, frame/pose association error or actual robot kinematic error.
